newsitem.title: UK: UK dairy sector shares boosted by Hoare comments.
newsitem.headline: UK dairy sector shares boosted by Hoare comments.

text.p: Shares in British dairy companies firmed on Wednesday after analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett issued a positive review of the sector, dealers said.

Market sources said the Hoare Govett report said margins in the dairy industry had fallen far enough and the outlook for the future was brighter. It restated "buy" recommendations on Unigate Plc, Dairy Crest Plc and Northern Foods Plc.
Unigate shares were 2-1/2p firmer at 452-1/2 by 1234 GMT, while Dairy Crest was up 7-1/2p at 208 and Northern Foods climbed 2-1/2p to 208.
